text:
Asha Reddy: alert: vendor invoice for NovaMetrics (acct ..5586) failed yesterday during scheduled autopay. invoices NM-6003 and NM-6004 impacted.
Ben Cho: what was decline code? any retries attempted?
billing-bot: system alert: payment_method=card_last4=5586 status=declined code=insufficient_funds attempts=1
CS-Marcus: reached out to vendor AP. they said their card hit monthly cap and will submit a wire today. asked for our wire details and any special remittance instructions.
Asha Reddy: copy our standard minimal wire template but do not include full account numbers in slack. ask them to send remittance email with invoice numbers + amounts. give them 48 hours to complete.
CS-Marcus: pasted to vendor: ```Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.
Bank: First Partner Bank
Routing/SWIFT: [please provide]
Reference: NovaMetrics + invoice numbers
Amount: USD XXXX```
CS-Marcus: vendor replied: "we can wire but our bank requires beneficiary address and bank branch identifier (BIC). can you provide?"
Asha Reddy: send beneficiary address via secure support channel (not Slack). ask vendor to confirm their intermediary bank for international wire. remind them to include invoice numbers in remittance.
Ben Cho: also ask vendor to upload proof of payment to the support ticket once wire initiated so AR can reconcile faster. set invoices to pending_wire.
billing-bot: action logged: set_status=pending_wire ticket=VN-7781 scheduled_followup=1778086400
AR-Sam: noted. threshold for service hold = $40,000, current outstanding = $19,320 so no immediate hold. add tags: pending_wire, vendor_high_touch.
Vendor-Payments-Bot: automated message: please do not post account numbers in public channels. use secure-upload for any bank docs.
CS-Marcus: vendor uploaded wire_ack.pdf to VN-7781 and wrote: "bank initiating wire today; expected settlement in 1-2 business days."
Ben Cho: uploaded file to ticket and set invoice status pending. scheduled manual reconciliation once proof of settlement shows in bank feed.
Asha Reddy: ok plan: Day0 one auto-retry attempted; Day1 pause + CS outreach; Day2 reconcile if funds landed; Day4 escalate to AR lead if not. if wire returns, offer ACH and collect ACH authorization via https://billing.redwood.ai/ach-setup.
AR-Sam: adding note to AR queue: apply payments to oldest invoice numbers first and attach vendor wire_ack.pdf. if partial payment received, apply to oldest and notify CS.
CS-Marcus: vendor asked whether we can accept partial payment to avoid interruption. i told them we can accept partials and will apply to oldest invoices; asked them to confirm amount in remittance.
Asha Reddy: agree. if they request temporary credit for service continuation we need approval from finance lead for amounts >$5k. current outstanding < threshold but final decision depends on finance lead.
Ben Cho: logging: follow-up reminder set for 1778086400 (~1 day).
billing-bot: reminder scheduled: check_ticket=VN-7781 remind_at=1778086400
Asha Reddy: closing loop here for now. ticket VN-7781 open and monitored. thanks team :thumbsup:
CS-Marcus: will update when remittance arrives.
AR-Sam: end of thread
